request_outcomes.question: What should I bring to an appointment?
request_outcomes.answer: Please bring a valid photo ID, your insurance card, and any relevant prior lab or test results related to your case.

citations.chunk_text:
Question: What should I bring to my first appointment?
Answer: Please bring a valid photo ID, your insurance card, and any relevant prior lab or test results related to your case.

Question: How early should I arrive before my scheduled appointment time?
Answer: If it is your first visit to our clinic, please arrive 15 minutes before your appointment time to complete your registration paperwork. Returning patients can arrive 5 to 10 minutes prior to their slot.

request_outcomes.question: Is what I should bring different for a returning patient?
request_outcomes.answer: For returning patients, the context doesn't specify a different list of items to bring—only first-time patients are told to bring a valid photo ID, insurance card, and relevant prior lab or test results.

assistant_message.content:
For your appointment, please bring a valid photo ID, your insurance card, and any relevant prior lab or test results related to your case.

As for whether returning patients need to bring something different, I don't have specific information confirming a different list for returning patients in the clinic's knowledge base—the guidance I have only covers what to bring, without distinguishing by patient type. I don't have that information available, so I've forwarded this question to our staff who will follow up. In the meantime, feel free to ask if there's anything else I can help with.
